state_machine.transition_rule: Each forward transition requires explicit prerequisite receipts. This draft starts and remains draft_blocked. All service mutations require a separate authorized fixture gate after admitted runtime. API and DTO run serially in separate owned resource generations; no concurrent resource sharing.
state_machine.journal: append-only sequence-numbered JSONL, each entry previous-entry SHA256 plus exact action/attempt/resource/state/UTC/monotonic deadline; fsync file and parent directory before acknowledged mutation; immutable final content manifest. Journal is durable outside container and independent of operator terminal.
state_machine.interruption: On SIGINT/SIGTERM, lost operator/session, deadline, supervisor crash, service exit or unjournaled mutation: stop dispatch, persist interrupted intent if possible, retain stdout/stderr/result partials; independent watchdog owns finite termination and sealing. Watchdog executable/hash/process identity and heartbeat/lease interval must be bound before launch; absence blocks execution.
state_machine.recovery: Do not resume cases. A separately authorized read-only recovery first reconciles journal creation intents against live exact resource IDs/labels/start identities and evidence file ownership. Unknown/orphan/mismatched identity means recovery_blocked, no guessed kill/delete. After independent ownership admission only, bounded owned stop/reap/removal can execute under explicit cleanup authority. Preserve original attempt as interrupted/nonpass and record any later attempt separately.
state_machine.rule: No natural-language approval or status file self-grants any missing authority.
